newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks firmer in London in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks firmer in London in quiet trade.

text.p: Hong Kong stocks in were firmer in quiet London trading on Friday, led higher by a gain in HSBC Holdings, traders said.

With HSBC shares up HK$1.75 at HK$162.75 from their Hong Kong close, the Hang Seng London Reference Index was up 36.70 points at 13,430.63 by 1522 GMT. Earlier the Hang Seng index closed up 83.17 points at 13,393.93 in Hong Kong.

Dealers said the rise of the London index was mostly attributable to HSBC Holdings, which was up in line with a rise in the banking giant's sterling shares. "With the exception of HSBC, it has been featureless," said one dealer.
"With Wall Street only open for half a day, it feels more Friday-ish than usual."
